name: Tuya Climate
description: The `tuya` climate platform creates a climate device from a tuya component.

config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name of the climate device. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

config_entries.label: Cooling State Pin
config_entries.description: The input pin indicating that the device is cooling - [see below](https://esphome.io/components/climate/tuya/#active-state-detection). Only used if **active_state_datapoint** is not configured.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Input
config_entries.description: Set the input mode flag.

config_entries.label: Output
config_entries.description: Set the output mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pullup
config_entries.description: Set the pullup mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pulldown
config_entries.description: Set the pulldown mode flag.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: Heating State Pin
config_entries.description: The input pin indicating that the device is heating - [see below](https://esphome.io/components/climate/tuya/#active-state-detection). Only used if **active_state_datapoint** is not configured.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Input
config_entries.description: Set the input mode flag.

config_entries.label: Output
config_entries.description: Set the output mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pullup
config_entries.description: Set the pullup mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pulldown
config_entries.description: Set the pulldown mode flag.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: Switch Datapoint
config_entries.description:
**Required — set at least one of:** `target_temperature_datapoint`, `switch_datapoint`.

The datapoint id number of the climate switch (device on/off).

config_entries.label: Target Temperature Datapoint
config_entries.description:
**Required — set at least one of:** `target_temperature_datapoint`, `switch_datapoint`.

The datapoint id number of the target temperature.

config_entries.label: Icon
config_entries.description: Manually set the icon to use for the climate device in the frontend.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for code generation. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

config_entries.label: Action State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish climate device action changes to.

config_entries.label: Active State
config_entries.description: Configuration for the Active State detection (or HVAC mode setting and reporting).

config_entries.label: Datapoint
config_entries.description: The datapoint id number of the active state - [see below](https://esphome.io/components/climate/tuya/#active-state-detection).

config_entries.label: Cooling Value
config_entries.description: The active state datapoint value when in cooling mode - [see below](https://esphome.io/components/climate/tuya/#active-state-detection).

config_entries.label: Drying Value
config_entries.description: The active state datapoint value when in drying mode.

config_entries.label: Fanonly Value
config_entries.description: The active state datapoint value when in fan-only mode.

config_entries.label: Heating Value
config_entries.description: The active state datapoint value when in heating mode. Defaults to `1` - [see below](https://esphome.io/components/climate/tuya/#active-state-detection).

config_entries.label: Current Humidity State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish current humidity changes to.

config_entries.label: Current Temperature Datapoint
config_entries.description: The datapoint id number of the current temperature.

config_entries.label: Current Temperature Multiplier
config_entries.description: A multiplier to modify the current temperature value.

config_entries.label: Current Temperature State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish current temperature changes to.

config_entries.label: Disabled By Default
config_entries.description: If true, then this entity should not be added to any client's frontend, (usually Home Assistant) without the user manually enabling it (via the Home Assistant UI). Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Entity Category
config_entries.description: The category of the entity. See [https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties) for a list of available options. Set to `""` to remove the default entity category.

config_entries.label: Fan Mode
config_entries.description: Configuration for fan modes/fan speeds.

config_entries.label: Datapoint
config_entries.description: The datapoint id number of the Fan value state.

config_entries.label: Auto Value
config_entries.description: The datapoint value the device reports when the fan is on `auto` speed.

config_entries.label: High Value
config_entries.description: The datapoint value the device reports when the fan is on `high` speed. (Sometimes called `Turbo`  ).

config_entries.label: Low Value
config_entries.description: The datapoint value the device reports when the fan is on `low` speed.

config_entries.label: Medium Value
config_entries.description: The datapoint value the device reports when the fan is on `medium` speed.

config_entries.label: Middle Value
config_entries.description: The datapoint value the device reports when the fan is on `middle` speed. (May set to device's `high` value if you have a `Turbo` option).

config_entries.label: Fan Mode Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive fan mode commands on.

config_entries.label: Fan Mode State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish fan mode changes to.

config_entries.label: Internal
config_entries.description: Mark this component as internal. Internal components will not be exposed to the frontend (like Home Assistant). Only specifying an `id` without a `name` will implicitly set this to true.

config_entries.label: Mode Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive climate device mode commands on.

config_entries.label: Mode State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish climate device mode changes to.

config_entries.label: Preset
config_entries.description: Configuration for presets.

config_entries.label: Eco
config_entries.description: Configuration for Eco preset.

config_entries.label: Datapoint
config_entries.description: The datapoint id number of the Eco action.

config_entries.label: Temperature
config_entries.description: Temperature setpoint for Eco preset.

config_entries.label: Sleep
config_entries.description: Configuration for Sleep preset

config_entries.label: Datapoint
config_entries.description: The Datapoint id number of the Sleep Action

config_entries.label: Preset Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive preset commands on.

config_entries.label: Preset State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish preset changes to.

config_entries.label: Reports Fahrenheit
config_entries.description: Set to `true` if the device reports temperatures in Fahrenheit. ESPHome expects all climate temperatures to be in Celcius, otherwise unexpected conversions will take place when it is published to Home Assistant. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Supports Cool
config_entries.description: Specifies if the device has a cooling mode. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Supports Heat
config_entries.description: Specifies if the device has a heating mode. Defaults to `true`.

config_entries.label: Swing Mode
config_entries.description: Configuration for the swing (oscillation) modes.

config_entries.label: Horizontal Datapoint
config_entries.description: The datapoint id number of the horizontal swing action.

config_entries.label: Vertical Datapoint
config_entries.description: The datapoint id number of the vertical swing action.

config_entries.label: Swing Mode Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive swing mode commands on.

config_entries.label: Swing Mode State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish swing mode changes to.

config_entries.label: Target Humidity Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive target humidity commands on.

config_entries.label: Target Humidity State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish target humidity changes to.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive target temperature commands on.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature High Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive higher target temperature commands on.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature High State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish higher target temperature changes to.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature Low Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive lower target temperature commands on.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature Low State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish lower target temperature changes to.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature Multiplier
config_entries.description: A multiplier to modify the target temperature value.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish target temperature changes to.

config_entries.label: Temperature Multiplier
config_entries.description: A multiplier to modify the incoming and outgoing temperature values - [see below](https://esphome.io/components/climate/tuya/#temperature-multiplier).

config_entries.label: Visual
config_entries.description: Visual settings for the climate device - these do not affect operation and are solely for controlling how the climate device shows up in the frontend.

config_entries.label: Max Humidity
config_entries.description: The maximum humidity the climate device can reach. Used to set the range of the frontend gauge.

config_entries.label: Max Temperature
config_entries.description: The maximum temperature that the AC unit supports being set to.

config_entries.label: Min Humidity
config_entries.description: The minimum humidity the climate device can reach. Used to set the range of the frontend gauge.

config_entries.label: Min Temperature
config_entries.description: The minimum temperature that the AC unit supports being set to.

config_entries.label: Temperature Step
config_entries.description: The granularity with which the target temperature can be controlled.
